description: Department of Local Government - Sabaragamuwa Province - Notify convene the First Meeting of the Local Govt. Authorities of Balangoda and 8 other L.G.'s in Sabaragamuwa Province
reasoning: This gazette content specifically concerns the convening of first meetings for Local Government Authorities in the Sabaragamuwa Province for the purpose of electing Mayors/Chairmen and Deputy Mayors/Deputy Chairmen. It contains a detailed schedule of election meetings with dates, times, and venues. This falls directly under electoral processes and related matters, making it a clear example of an Elections Gazette (Type 7).
